title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description_html: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated  Senior Data Platform Engineer, AVP (Python/PySpark, Microsoft SSIS, SQL Server, ETL & Database Development)  to design, develop, enhance, and support robust, scalable, and high-performance data processing solutions.  The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on expertise in  Python/PySpark, SQL Server, ETL/data pipelines, Microsoft SSIS, and large-scale data platforms , with experience troubleshooting production data applications, optimizing database performance, and working across enterprise data environments.  The candidate will be working independently on complex assignments while collaborating with engineering , infrastructure, and business teams.    Responsibilities:       Data Pipeline & ETL Development:  Design, develop, test, and support scalable ETL/data-processing pipelines using Python/PySpark, Microsoft BI/SSIS, SQL, and related technologies.   SQL Server Development:  Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, data transformations, and database objects for high-volume applications.   Database Performance:  Identify and resolve query and database performance issues through execution-plan analysis, indexing, query optimization, statistics, and appropriate database design techniques.   Large-Scale Data Processing:  Develop and support solutions processing large data volumes across SQL Server and distributed data platforms.   Data Architecture & Modeling:  Apply relational, dimensional, and data-warehouse modeling principles to build scalable and maintainable data solutions.   Production Support & Troubleshooting:  Analyze failed jobs, data-quality issues, performance problems, and production incidents; perform root-cause analysis and implement sustainable resolutions.   Job Scheduling & Automation:  Develop and support enterprise batch-processing workflows using scheduling/orchestration platforms such as AutoSys.   Big Data Platforms:  Work with Hadoop ecosystem technologies including HDFS, Hive and related distributed-processing technologies.   Data Quality & Reconciliation:  Implement validation, reconciliation, exception handling, logging, monitoring, and data-quality controls within data pipelines.   Code Quality:  Participate in code reviews and enforce development standards for SQL, Python/PySpark, ETL, and data-processing components.   DevOps:  Use Git-based source control and participate in CI/CD processes; work with container technologies such as Docker/Kubernetes where applicable.   Security:  Follow secure data-development practices, access-control requirements, encryption standards, and organizational security policies.   Technical Collaboration:  Work closely  with application developers, infrastructure teams, business teams, and other technology groups to design and deliver solutions.   Continuous Improvement & AI:  Evaluate new technologies and leverage approved AI-assisted development tools to improve code quality, troubleshooting, refactoring, and developer productivity.  Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm’s reputation and safeguarding the firm, its clients, and assets while complying with applicable laws, rules, regulations, and policies.      Recommended Qualifications:      4+ years  of relevant experience in data engineering, application development, database development, or related technology roles.  Strong hands-on experience with Python and PySpark for large-scale data processing and ETL development.  Strong proficiency in SQL/T-SQL and relational database technologies, preferably Microsoft SQL Server.  Experience developing and supporting complex SQL queries, stored procedures, database objects, and high-volume data-processing solutions.  Strong understanding of SQL Server performance tuning, including query execution plans, indexing, statistics, joins, locking/blocking, and query optimization.  Experience with Microsoft BI/SSIS or comparable enterprise ETL technologies.  Experience working with large datasets and distributed data platforms such as Hadoop/HDFS/Hive.  Strong understanding of ETL architecture, data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and relational/3NF modeling.  Experience implementing data-quality checks, reconciliation, audit controls, exception handling, and production monitoring.  Experience with enterprise scheduling/orchestration tools such as AutoSys.  Experience with Git, CI/CD, and modern development practices.  Familiarity with Docker/Kubernetes is preferred.  Familiarity with NoSQL technologies such as MongoDB is beneficial.  Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.  Ability to work independently on complex technical assignments while collaborating effectively across teams. Job Description:          HPE is looking for a Channel Presales Technical Architect to grow technical advocacy for HPE storage solutions across our partner community. You'll be the trusted technical advisor to our top channel partners. You'll help their teams position, design and deliver HPE storage and data protection solutions for their customers, and turn that partner capability into pipeline and revenue growth.   This role combines deep storage architecture expertise with partner enablement. You'll work alongside partner sellers and engineers on live opportunities, and you'll also build their long-term ability to lead with HPE on their own.   What you'll do:   Partner technical advocacy and enablement   Build strong, lasting relationships with partner technical and sales teams, and become their go-to resource for HPE storage.    Grow the number of partner engineers who can confidently position, demo and design HPE storage solutions, through enablement sessions, workshops, whiteboarding and hands-on labs.    Identify and develop technical champions within partner organizations, and support their progress through HPE certifications and partner program requirements.    Represent HPE at partner events, tech days and customer-facing briefings.    Solution architecture and opportunity support   Join deep-dive discussions with partners and end customers to understand technical needs and assess current IT infrastructure. Protect and expand HPE's footprint through the partner community by driving new technology adoption, upgrades and refreshes across the installed base. Ensure a smooth handoff from sale to implementation by orienting partners and internal teams to the solution design and identifying training needs.    What you bring   Education and experience:   Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.    5+ years of technical presales experience with a major storage vendor or storage-focused channel partner.    Deep hands-on expertise in pitching, demoing and architecting complex storage solutions.    Demonstrated knowledge of virtualization, including VMware or KVM-based environments, and at least two application stacks (such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle or SAP).    Hands-on working knowledge of at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud); certifications preferred.    Expertise across the full data lifecycle: block, file, backup, ransomware protection and related solutions.    Deep competitive knowledge of at least one major storage vendor.    Expertise in at least one major vertical (financial services, manufacturing or healthcare) and its related solutions is preferred.    Knowledge and skills   Strong knowledge of channel partner business models and offerings, with proven ability to engage, collaborate with and technically enable partners throughout the sales cycle.    Excellent consultative selling skills, including active listening, framing, whiteboarding and storytelling.    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting to technical teams and business executives alike.    Strong knowledge of storage industry trends, competitor products and strategies.    Strong business and financial acumen, with an understanding of the roles and priorities of different customer stakeholders.    Solid project management, analytical and problem-solving skills.    Familiarity with CRM systems and sales tools, and comfort using social media and other channels to share technical content.    Storage-related industry certifications strongly preferred.
